sections.title: Letter T
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (T) /t/. Its main sound is heard in the word (top) /tɑp/, which means the highest part of something. This letter makes two spoken sounds in English, and in some words it is silent.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Press your tongue tip against the ridge behind your upper teeth. Stop the breath completely. Release the air with a quick burst. Your vocal cords do not vibrate. For the other sound, tap your tongue tip very quickly against that same ridge without stopping the air completely. Your vocal cords vibrate during this quick tap. Touch your throat to feel the vibration.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter usually sounds like the burst in (ten) /tɛn/ or at the end of (cat) /kæt/. Between two vowels before a syllable with less strength, it sounds like the quick tap in (butter) /bʌ.tər/ or (city) /sɪ.ti/. In some words, such as (listen) /lɪs.ən/ or (castle) /kæs.əl/, the letter is not pronounced at all.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not press your tongue flat against the back of your front teeth. In English, place your tongue tip higher up on the hard ridge behind your teeth. Make sure you do not use your voice when you say the regular burst sound.
